## What

Describe the change in two or three sentences.

## Why

What failure does this prevent, or what user problem does it solve? Link the
issue with `Closes #N`.

## Scope

- [ ] Parser
- [ ] Rule
- [ ] CLI
- [ ] Report format
- [ ] Configuration
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tests or CI

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run check:clean` exits 0
- [ ] `npm run check:broken` exits non-zero
- [ ] New behaviour has a test or a documented reason it cannot have one

## Notes for review

Anything a reviewer should know: trade-offs, follow-up work, or a part of the
change that is deliberately out of scope.
